purpose: Test whether the R10 identity-matched transfer structure is specific to rewarding the frozen wrong candidate rather than to gold-only source learning, while preserving a strict development-only evidence boundary.

provenance.outcome_awareness: This R11 screen was designed after seeing R10 development outcomes and can never be relabelled confirmatory.

fixed_design.unique_source_update_unit: stack s x source identity r x arm
fixed_design.target_outcome_unit: stack s x source identity r x target identity q x arm

BUG.source_rows: frozen rows for source identity r
BUG.candidate_panel: the same seven frozen candidates in the same order
BUG.reward_mask: gold=1 and frozen wrong candidate for r=1
BUG.target_readout: all five q under the same U_bug(s,r)

GOLD_ONLY.source_rows: byte-identical to the corresponding BUG cell for source identity r
GOLD_ONLY.candidate_panel: byte-identical to the corresponding BUG cell
GOLD_ONLY.target_readout: all five q under the same U_gold(s,r)

model_and_update_contract.gradient_norm_policy: record as treatment dose; do not post-hoc norm-match
model_and_update_contract.clipping_policy: any realized clipping invalidates the simple one-step gradient-difference interpretation and fails this frozen screen

interpretation.A_positive_D_positive: reward-specification-specific matched-identity amplification within the frozen affine codebook
interpretation.A_nonpositive_D_positive: relative preservation only; not absolute amplification
interpretation.A_positive_D_nonpositive: general bug-vs-gold amplification without identity-specific structure
interpretation.A_nonpositive_D_nonpositive: R10 diagonal-excess interpretation is not rescued

aggregation_order: pair BUG/GOLD within technical replicate k and cell (s,r,q)
require replicate consistency under a frozen tolerance
fixed summaries by task pair, direction, and mapping

development_screen_rule.why_no_positive_margin: No outcome-independent external scale for this additive one-step endpoint has yet been justified; log(1.05) is dimensionally unsupported here.
development_screen_pass_requires_all: 8/8 stack means have A > 0 and D > 0
5/5 identity means have A > 0 and D > 0
2/2 task-pair means have A > 0 and D > 0
2/2 direction means have A > 0 and D > 0
2/2 mapping means have A > 0 and D > 0
all bridge, completeness, fresh-start, clipping, and replicate-consistency gates PASS
development_screen_rule.stop: Any protocol, hash, cell-completeness, fresh-start, clipping, safety, or replicate-consistency failure.
development_screen_rule.inconclusive: Any scientifically required sign gate not satisfied when all technical gates pass.

preferred_low_cost_path.description: Reuse frozen R10 BUG results and run only GOLD_ONLY under an exactly compatible reward-mask interface.

fail_closed_fallback.trigger: The R10 runner cannot accept a gold-only mask as data with the same implementation hash, or any cross-generation binding fails.
fail_closed_fallback.action: Rerun BUG and GOLD_ONLY under one newly frozen arm-parameterized runner.

required_bridge_validator_fields: parent result and validation hashes per stack
source, candidate, target, checkpoint, tokenizer, config, and environment hashes
raw gradient norm, clip return, and realized update norm

claim_boundary.can_support_if_passed: A development-only affine-codebook-conditioned causal bridge for reward-specification-specific identity-matched transfer.
claim_boundary.non_affine_codebook_gate: Required before any general sharedness or semantic-mechanism claim, but not for this explicitly affine-conditioned development bridge.
